summary: Check each changed design against the model in the commit that last changed that design, so a later model change in the same comparison range does not reject an earlier design. A design that is uncommitted, or that no commit in the range changed, uses the checkout model. At least one changed design must also pass the checkout model, so a model change that no design covers still fails. The snapshot model comes from Git history with the existing fixed read-only Git commands and the existing strict JSON decoder and model compiler. targetBaseline and the snapshot read share one helper that reads a regular file from a commit. The helper removes one lint finding, so the lint baseline shrinks. No production Go code, import, CLI flag, configuration key, JSON report field, or exit code changes.
trust_boundaries: No trust boundary changes. The checker reads the model from local Git history with the existing fixed Git commands. It executes no candidate code and uses no network.
